title: Emerald Hare Oracle
description: A green anthropomorphic hare with large ears and a glowing red eye stands in the foreground, draped in translucent white cloth with mathematical symbols. Behind it, floating in a dark surreal space, is an ornate bowl emitting light with a small orbiting object above, surrounded by shattered iridescent glass shards and scattered playing cards.
prompt: A green anthropomorphic hare with long ears and a single glowing red eye, wearing translucent white cloth covered in mathematical equations, stands amid floating shattered iridescent glass shards and scattered playing cards. In the dark background, an ornate floating bowl emits soft light with a small celestial orb hovering above it, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, detailed digital painting.
